: The Illusion of the Great Emperor (: The Illusion of the Great Emperor (page 22)) Suddenly a powerful power burst out, the silver faded, and Mo Feng's figure rushed out. The two were startled. When they looked up, they saw Mo Feng's face pale in the sky, and his clothes were already gone. It was in tatters, blood was constantly flowing from the mouth, and the breath was at least half weaker than before. At this moment, the dark wind blew violently again, and the wind blew up the underground sand and gravel several feet high, spinning like countless pillars. Uncertain. If Li Tianle thinks about it, he will get rid of all these disciples. It would be strange if the other party doesn't show up. It seems that the boss and the others have encountered something terrible before, and they were forced to hide in this funeral. Come to the hall. Moreover, it is very likely that this matter is related to the Taoist priest. Four or five feet further away, Zhang Jingxuan, Wang Beiming, and Cao Qianwan, who have good ears and powerful skills, all heard the faint moaning sound, which sounded like a man. Fan said disdainfully, looking at Zhang Heng like he was looking at a fool, and the security guards next to him also laughed. In their opinion, Mo Feng, a man as ugly as a dog, is not worthy of living with them, and he can only guard the door below. Not to mention Pei Lingxu, the quasi-emperor, there are three heavenly beings and nine Xiaoyao peaks in his direct lineage. Nie Feng came back in a hurry this time and did not dress up. He was still wearing silk clothes, which did not match the car at all. But this is not a bad thing. After all, I am going back to my hometown. It is more comfortable to wear something casual and have fun with the people. From going to Songhai, experiencing life and death catastrophes, to the auction, fighting against many masters, and defeating the Chen Peng brothers, at this point, the duel was finally completed. Mr. Xiao's treatment. He was too tired from working for the Xiao family. "There is actually a record of the location of the core of the world, and it's not just one copy, but several copies." Li Fan couldn't help but look ecstatic after deciphering the content.
